title: Second projection of an encoded pair
statement: For any finite bit strings $a$ and $b$, the total second projection of their self-delimiting pair encoding is $b$.
replaced: Let $\langle a,b\rangle$ denote the self-delimiting pair encoding of bit strings $a$ and $b$ (every bit of $a$ doubled, then $01$, then $b$), and let $\pi_2$ be the total second projection, which returns the second component of a pair encoding and the empty word on any other bit string. Then $\pi_2(\langle a,b\rangle) = b$ for all bit strings $a, b$.
